transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you here today?

I... um... I'm just having a really hard time lately. Ever since the foreclosure notices started coming in the mail, I just... I don't know. I feel like I'm coming apart at the seams. I've been sitting in my truck crying before my shift starts. And I jump every time the phone rings. I've been snapping at the apprentices at the shop, too, and making stupid mistakes in the repair bay that I never would've made before. It's just... a lot.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried most of the time since this situation with the foreclosure started?
I guess so. Yeah. Just... always worried about what's going to happen next.
Have you noticed any physical symptoms, like a racing heart, sweating, or shaking, when you feel anxious about the foreclosure?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that. Just... what I already said.
Do you find that your anxiety continues even when there’s nothing specific going on, or does it only happen when you’re thinking about the foreclosure situation?
I don't really know. It's... mostly just when I think about the house, I guess. If I'm not thinking about it, it's not as bad.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy since this started?

I don't know about hopeless. But... I guess I haven't been doing much. I stopped showing up for church volunteering, and my fitness classes. Haven't been to any of the truck-club outings either. I just... stopped going. 

And at the shop... they actually took me out of the high-risk repair bay. So... yeah. I guess you could say that.
Have you felt down or lost interest in things you usually enjoy most days, even when you're not thinking about the foreclosure?
I don't know about most days. I just... I don't feel like doing those things right now. It's hard to separate it all out.
Have you felt down or had a low mood even on days when you weren’t thinking about the foreclosure situation?
I... I don't really keep track of days like that. It's just... it's always kind of there in the background, I guess. I don't know.
Can you think of a day in the past couple of weeks where you weren’t thinking about the foreclosure, and if on that day, you still felt down or in a low mood?
I don't think there's been a day where I wasn't thinking about it. It's... it's my house. It's hard to just turn that off.
Can you remember feeling down or in a low mood even for a short while on a day when the foreclosure wasn’t on your mind?
No... I really can't. Like I said, it's always on my mind. I don't know how else to answer that.
Can you recall any time in the past few weeks when you were not thinking about the foreclosure, even briefly, and if so, how did you feel emotionally during those moments?
I... I don't know what you want me to say. I just told you, it's always there. I can't just forget about it.
Have you noticed yourself feeling anxious or on edge even when you're not thinking about things related to the shop, your job, or the house?
No... I haven't noticed that. I mean, like I keep saying, I'm always thinking about those things. So... no. I don't really know.
Have you ever felt anxious or worried when there wasn’t anything specific on your mind, like when you’re just sitting quietly or doing something routine?
No, I... I really don't. It's just... the shop, the house... that's what's always there. I don't just sit and feel worried for no reason. It's... it's all because of what's happening.
Have you ever noticed yourself feeling anxious or worried when there wasn't anything specific happening around you, like when you're alone, quiet, or away from work or home stressors?
I... I feel like you just asked me that. No. Like I said... I don't just get worried out of nowhere. It's always about the shop or losing the house. I really don't know what else to tell you.
